subject.title: Execution anti-drift guards: artifact-gated status, escalation timers, and no-idle-after-green

question: After #102160, should #47606 remain as the canonical artifact-gated status/no-idle-after-green guardrail, be split into narrower follow-ups, or close as covered by #101863?
rationale: The broad liveness tracks landed, but source and docs still show adjacent loop/liveness guards rather than the requested artifact-gated status contract, feature flag, and no-idle-after-green policy.

options.title: Narrow Remaining Guardrail
options.body: Keep this issue open but scope it to artifact-gated progress/status, no-idle-after-green, and telemetry that #102160 did not cover.

options.title: Split To Existing Follow-Ups
options.body: Move no-start/progress-SLA and channel no-settlement pieces to #77771 and #95630, then close this umbrella as tracked elsewhere.

options.title: Accept #101863 As Sufficient
options.body: Close this issue if maintainers do not want a separate artifact-gated status contract beyond the landed lifecycle reliability work.

recommendation.title: Narrow Remaining Guardrail
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open but scope it to artifact-gated progress/status, no-idle-after-green, and telemetry that #102160 did not cover.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the completed run-lifecycle umbrella and are best positioned to decide whether the remaining guardrail scope should stay separate.
